Flight Data

Drop CSV / KML Files / Click to Select
Supports Flightradar24 export CSV and FlightAware KML files.
Load multiple files at once (1 file = 1 flight).

CSV format: Timestamp,UTC,Callsign,Position,Altitude,Speed,Direction (Position is "latitude,longitude"). FlightAware KML files (gx:Track) are also supported: the Callsign is read from the track name inside the file, altitude is converted from metres to feet, and speed / direction are derived from the positions and timestamps. When multiple files are loaded, they are automatically sorted by each file's first timestamp, in both the list and playback order (re-sorted when files are added later). Playback uses a compressed timeline that plays flights back-to-back and skips the gaps between them. Use the eye icon to show/hide a flight; click a flight to move the playhead to it (this only moves — it does not start playback). All flights share one trail / aircraft color, changed in bulk from Settings > Trail & Aircraft Color. The 3D label above the aircraft shows the Callsign from the file at that moment.
